remarks: Welcome to 34 Munger St in the Village of Bergen! This well-maintained ranch offers 3 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and a wonderful blend of classic character and thoughtful updates. Original hardwood floors, arched doorways, and built-ins add timeless charm, while the updated kitchen features natural wood cabinetry and solid surface countertops. The inviting family room boasts a gas fireplace, and the finished basement expands the living space with a rec room, full bath, and additional storage. The primary suite features a full bath and cedar-lined walk-in closet. Enjoy the convenience of first-floor laundry and mudroom, updated baths, vinyl replacement windows, and a 2.5-car attached garage. Step outside to a fully fenced backyard, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Major updates include a new roof in 2022, water heater in 2021, AC unit updated in 2023 and furnace in 2014. A well-maintained home offering classic charm, flexible living space, and practical updates in a convenient village location! Offers to be reviewed Tuesday, October 27th,2026 at 1pm.
